source.quote: MDSW intended to perform diagnosis by means of image analysis for making treatment decisions in patients with acute stroke should be classified as class III under Rule 11(a) IMDRF Risk Category IV.i as the healthcare situation (stroke) is critical and the significance of the information is “treat or diagnose”.

interpretation.uk: Діагностика для лікувальних рішень при інсульті: хибна інформація може спричинити смерть чи незворотне погіршення (11a, i). IMDRF IV.i — критична ситуація × лікувати/діагностувати.
interpretation.en: Diagnosis for treatment decisions in stroke: incorrect information may cause death or irreversible deterioration (11a, i). IMDRF IV.i — critical situation × treat or diagnose.

title.en: Cognitive therapy chosen by a specialist

source.quote: When a specialist determines the necessary cognitive therapy based on the outcome provided by the MDSW, the MDSW would be classified as class IIa per Rule 11(a). - IMDRF Risk Category II.ii as the healthcare situation is serious and the significance of the information is to “drive clinical management”.

interpretation.uk: Рішення ухвалює спеціаліст; винятки 11a не застосовні. IMDRF II.ii — серйозна ситуація × керувати веденням. (Варіант, де ПЗ саме змінює терапію, — правило 22, у демо не закодоване.)
interpretation.en: The specialist decides; the 11a exceptions do not apply. IMDRF II.ii — serious situation × drive clinical management. (The variant where the software adapts therapy itself is Rule 22, not encoded in this demo.)

title.uk: Постійне спостереження життєвих параметрів у реанімації
title.en: Continuous vital-sign surveillance in intensive care

source.quote: Medical devices including MDSW intended to be used for continuous surveillance of vital physiological processes in anaesthesia, intensive care or emergency care should be classified as class IIb per (Rule 11(b)).

interpretation.uk: ПЗ лише для моніторингу (11b) життєвих параметрів, зміни яких можуть створити безпосередню небезпеку.
interpretation.en: Software for monitoring only (11b) of vital parameters whose variations could result in immediate danger.

source.quote: Medical devices, including MDSW intended to monitor physiological processes that are not considered to be vital, and devices intended to be used to obtain readings of vital physiological signals in routine check-ups including monitoring at home should be classified as class IIa (Rule 11(b)).

interpretation.uk: Перша половина прикладу: моніторинг процесів, що не є життєво важливими (11b, без винятку).
interpretation.en: First half of the example: monitoring processes that are not vital (11b, no exception).

source.quote: Medical devices, including MDSW intended to monitor physiological processes that are not considered to be vital, and devices intended to be used to obtain readings of vital physiological signals in routine check-ups including monitoring at home should be classified as class IIa (Rule 11(b)).

interpretation.uk: Друга половина прикладу: життєві параметри при планових оглядах і вдома — зміни не створюють безпосередньої небезпеки (11b без винятку).
interpretation.en: Second half of the example: vital signs in routine check-ups and at home — the variations do not create immediate danger (11b without the exception).

source.quote: A mobile app intended to analyse a user’s heartbeat, detect abnormalities and inform a physician accordingly should be classified as class IIb per Rule 11(a), if the information provided by the software is intended to guide the physician in the diagnosis. - IMDRF Risk Category III.i as the information drives clinical management.

interpretation.uk: Інформація спрямовує лікаря в діагностиці; хибна може спричинити серйозне погіршення (11a, ii). IMDRF III.i — критична ситуація × керувати веденням.
interpretation.en: The information guides the physician's diagnosis; incorrect information may cause serious deterioration (11a, ii). IMDRF III.i — critical situation × drive clinical management.

source.quote: Diagnostic MDSW intended for scoring depression based on inputted data on a patient’s symptoms (e.g. mood, anxiety) should be classified as class IIb under Rule 11(a), - (IMDRF Risk Category III.ii) as the healthcare situation (depression) is serious and the significance of the information is “diagnosis”).

interpretation.uk: Діагноз депресії: хибний може спричинити серйозне погіршення (11a, ii). IMDRF III.ii — серйозна ситуація × діагностувати.
interpretation.en: A depression diagnosis: an incorrect one may cause serious deterioration (11a, ii). IMDRF III.ii — serious situation × diagnose.

source.quote: MDSW intended to rank therapeutic suggestions for a health care professional based on patient history, imaging test results, and patient characteristics, for example, MDSW that lists and ranks all available chemotherapy options for BRCA-positive individuals, should be classified as class IIa per Rule 11(a) - IMDRF Risk Category II.i as it informs clinical management for cancer, a critical disease.

interpretation.uk: ПЗ лише інформує фахівця, тож винятки 11a не застосовні, хоч рак — критичний стан. IMDRF II.i — критична ситуація × інформувати.
interpretation.en: The software only informs the professional, so the 11a exceptions do not apply although cancer is critical. IMDRF II.i — critical situation × inform.

source.quote: MDSW app intended to support conception by calculating the user’s fertility status based on a validated statistical algorithm. The user inputs health data including basal body temperature (BBT) and menstruation days to track and predict ovulation. The fertility status of the current day is reflected by one of three indicator lights: red (fertile), green (infertile) or yellow (learning phase/cycle fluctuation). This MDSW app should be classified as class I per Rule 11c.

interpretation.uk: Підтримка зачаття — медичне призначення за ст. 2(1), але без діагностичних чи лікувальних рішень і без моніторингу в сенсі 11b, тож 11c.
interpretation.en: Support of conception is a medical purpose under Article 2(1), but with no diagnostic or therapeutic decisions and no monitoring in the sense of 11b, hence 11c.

title.uk: Застосунок для людей з порушенням мовлення
title.en: App for people with a communication disorder

source.quote: MDSW app intended to assist persons with a communication disorder (e.g. cerebral palsy, autism (ASD), selective mutism, MS, MND, Down’s syndrome, aphasia, etc.) talk by converting a set of selected symbols into spoken language. Depending on the patient’s medical status, the selection can be done through various means such as a touch screen, head tracking or eye gaze. This MDSW app should be classified as class I per Rule 11c.

interpretation.uk: Компенсація інвалідності — медичне призначення, але без рішень з діагностичною чи лікувальною метою і без моніторингу: 11c.
interpretation.en: Compensation for a disability is a medical purpose, but with no decisions with diagnosis or therapeutic purposes and no monitoring: 11c.

title.uk: Аналіз меланоми, що керує лазерним сканером
title.en: Melanoma analysis driving a laser scanner

source.quote: Melanoma image analysis software intended to be used with a near-infrared laser light scanner, which is considered class IIa per Rule 10. The software “drives or influences the use of” the near-infrared laser light scanner as it is intended to take control of the scanner by letting it execute proprietary multi-exposure programs for the detection of melanoma. As such, implementing rule 3.3 applies. However, Rule 11 would also apply based on the intended medical purpose of the software e.g. cancer diagnosis. The MDSW would be classified as class III based on Rule 11 (see section Classification Rules) and per implementing rule 3.5 of Annex VIII.

interpretation.uk: Правило 3.3 дає клас сканера (IIa), правило 11 за власним призначенням (діагностика раку) — III; за правилом 3.5 перемагає суворіше. Діагноз раку прочитано як рішення з можливим незворотним погіршенням.
interpretation.en: Rule 3.3 gives the scanner's class (IIa), Rule 11 for its own purpose (cancer diagnosis) gives III; rule 3.5 picks the stricter. Cancer diagnosis is read as a decision that may cause irreversible deterioration.

source.quote: For example, a device intended to prevent the risk of illnesses or pathologies by analysing physiological parameters (e.g. placement of the dorsal vertebrae, analysis of arterial stiffness, etc.) can be considered as a device providing information which is used to take decisions with diagnosis purpose (potential detection of pathologies) and in this case is in class IIa.

interpretation.uk: Інформація для рішень з діагностичною метою (можливе виявлення патологій); винятки 11a не застосовні.
interpretation.en: Information for decisions with a diagnostic purpose (potential detection of pathologies); the 11a exceptions do not apply.

source.quote: Step 4 is answered “no” as the software does not perform this action for the benefit of individual patients. The conclusion is that the software does not fall under the Medical Devices Regulations.

also.quote: A software module which runs on an in vitro diagnostic medical device instrument and tracks how the laboratory is performing in real-time on key operational metrics such as test volumes, turnaround times, pending tests, and quality control.

interpretation.uk: Крок 1 — так; крок 2 — ні (не додаток XVI, не аксесуар, не керує виробом); крок 3 — так; крок 4 — ні: операційні метрики лабораторії, а не користь окремих пацієнтів.
interpretation.en: Step 1 yes; step 2 no (not Annex XVI, not an accessory, does not drive a device); step 3 yes; step 4 no: operational metrics of the laboratory, not a benefit for individual patients.

source.quote: Typically, they are intended for patient admission, for scheduling patient appointments, for insurance and billing purposes. HIS are not in themselves qualified as medical devices.

interpretation.uk: Обробляє дані окремих пацієнтів, але для прийому, розкладу, страхування й рахунків — без медичного призначення (крок 5 — ні).
interpretation.en: It processes individual patients' data, but for admission, scheduling, insurance and billing — no medical purpose (step 5 no).

title.uk: Телемедицина, що лише передає й показує дані
title.en: Telemedicine that only transfers and displays data

source.quote: Telemedicine that solely transfers and displays information for monitoring purposes without interpreting data does not qualify as a medical device.

interpretation.uk: Лише передавання й показ без інтерпретації — дії не понад зберігання й комунікацію (крок 3 — ні).
interpretation.en: Only transfer and display without interpretation — no action beyond storage and communication (step 3 no).

source.quote: For example, software analogous to diaries for recording insulin doses would not be considered devices, unless an analysis is performed on the data or the device in some way alters the patients treatment, prescription, doses etc.

interpretation.uk: Лише записує дози, без аналізу даних (крок 3 — ні).
interpretation.en: It only records doses, with no analysis of the data (step 3 no).

source.quote: In addition, software only intended for non-medical purposes (excluding MDR Annex XVI devices), such as invoicing, staff planning, e-mailing, web or voice messaging, data parsing, word processing, and back-up, wellness or fitness apps, do not qualify as MDSW.

interpretation.uk: Обробляє дані користувача, але без медичного призначення (крок 5 — ні).
interpretation.en: It processes the user's data, but with no medical purpose (step 5 no).

source.quote: A software module generating alarms based on the monitoring and analysis of patient specific physiological parameters is qualified as a medical device (MDSW).

interpretation.uk: Аналізує фізіологічні параметри конкретного пацієнта з медичною метою (кроки 3–5 — так).
interpretation.en: It analyses a specific patient's physiological parameters for a medical purpose (steps 3–5 yes).

source.quote: MDSW smartwatch app, which is intended to send alarm notifications to the user and/or health practitioner when it recognises irregular heartbeats for the purpose of detecting cardiac arrhythmia.

interpretation.uk: Розпізнає нерегулярне серцебиття окремого користувача для виявлення аритмії — медичне призначення.
interpretation.en: It recognises an individual user's irregular heartbeats to detect arrhythmia — a medical purpose.

title.en: Remote control of a surgical robot

source.quote: Remote control software used in combination with telesurgery robots is a software that drives or influences the use of a medical device.

interpretation.uk: Керує роботом, але власного медичного призначення не має: регулюється разом із роботом (крок 2), клас — клас робота (правило 3.3).
interpretation.en: It drives the robot but has no medical purpose of its own: regulated with the robot (step 2), with the robot's class (rule 3.3).

source.quote: A MDAI is considered a high-risk AI system under Article 6(1) AIA if it meets both of the following conditions:

interpretation.uk: Рядок «MDR Class IIa, IIb, III» таблиці 1 MDCG 2025-6 (с. 6): нотифікований орган — так, умови ст. 6(1) — так. Значення клітинок прочитано з макета таблиці: витягнутий текст їх перемішує. Профіль — ранжування хіміотерапії з AI.
interpretation.en: Row 'MDR Class IIa, IIb, III' of MDCG 2025-6 Table 1 (p. 6): notified body — yes, Article 6(1) conditions — yes. The cell values are read from the table layout; the extracted text scrambles them. Profile: chemotherapy ranking with AI.

title.en: AI software of class I without measuring

source.quote: A MDAI is considered a high-risk AI system under Article 6(1) AIA if it meets both of the following conditions:

also.quote: MDR Class I (non-sterile, non-measuring, nonreusable surgical)

interpretation.uk: Рядок «MDR Class I (non-sterile, non-measuring, non-reusable surgical)» таблиці 1 (с. 6): нотифікований орган — ні, ст. 6(1) — ні. Профіль — застосунок для зачаття з AI.
interpretation.en: Row 'MDR Class I (non-sterile, non-measuring, non-reusable surgical)' of Table 1 (p. 6): notified body — no, Article 6(1) — no. Profile: the conception app with AI.

title.uk: AI-ПЗ класу I з функцією вимірювання
title.en: AI software of class I with a measuring function

source.quote: A MDAI is considered a high-risk AI system under Article 6(1) AIA if it meets both of the following conditions:

also.quote: MDR Class I (sterile, measuring, reusable surgical)

interpretation.uk: Рядок «MDR Class I (sterile, measuring, reusable surgical)» таблиці 1 (с. 6): нотифікований орган — так, ст. 6(1) — так. Профіль сконструйовано з рядка таблиці: ПЗ класу I з функцією вимірювання.
interpretation.en: Row 'MDR Class I (sterile, measuring, reusable surgical)' of Table 1 (p. 6): notified body — yes, Article 6(1) — yes. The profile is constructed from the table row: class I software with a measuring function.
